page.overview:
Who is Allegra?

Rabbid Mario Princess Peach Rabbid Peach Luigi Rabbid Luigi Edge Rabbid Rosalina Bowser A Dorrie

Allegra is an allied NPC in Mario + Rabbids Sparks of Hope, making her only appearance in the second DLC titled The Last Spark Hunter. She is the warden of the jungle-like Melodic Gardens.

Allegra is somewhat tall and lean. She has black stringy hair and blue eyes and purple face paint and wears a leafy dress. She also wears green arm bands and a necklace with rocks on it.

Allegra is first seen as a cautious character, as she spies on Mario, Luigi, Princess Peach, Bowser, Beep-0, JEANIE, and the five Rabbids allied with them during the group's exploration of the Melodic Gardens. She later warms up to the heroes after witnessing them save the musicians. She cares for everyone allied with her, especially the Dorrie she keeps as a pet, as when she reunites with him, she hugs the creature. Allegra is not afraid of danger, and she will do anything to protect her friends and the Melodic Gardens.
